ActorTalk: Fancy running into you at F.O.S.! Still the same scared little Laureate kid, huh?
Ha. Says the hot-headed brute from Blade Department.
If they hadn't scrapped the old division system and the inter-academy combat drills, you'd have learned firsthand what it feels like to get outplayed start to finish.
Come on! Our department took first place plenty of times too.
Anyway, forget it. That last mission would've gone sideways without your intel. I never got to thank you properly. Laureate students really are the best at analysis and coordination. Thanks.
You're surprisingly straightforward. Very Blade Squad of you.
Just doing my job. Intel's only useful if someone's still alive to act on it. You fight on the frontlines. Stay safe.
